title: AWS Lambda to Amazon Comprehend
description: Create a Lambda function that uses Amazon Comprehend for sentiment analysis.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern shows how to deploy a SAM template that builds a Lambda function which triggers Comprehend for sentiment analysis.

bullets.text: Using AWS Lambda and Amazon Comprehend for sentiment analysis

testing.headline: Testing
text: Use the AWS CLI to invoke the Lambda function. The function name is in the outputs of the AWS SAM deployment (the key is QueuePublisherFunction):
1. Invoke the Lambda function to publish a message to the SQS queue: aws lambda invoke --function-name ENTER_YOUR_FUNCTION_NAME outfile.txt.
2. Retrieve the message from the SQS queue, using the queue URL from the AWS SAM deployment outputs: aws sqs receive-message --queue-url ENTER_YOUR_QUEUE_URL

cleanup.headline: Cleanup
text: See the GitHub repo for testing instructions.
